protocol.primary_speed: Mean complete time from reading recorded touches through PLY export across the ten 600 s outputs, CPU and CUDA in alternating order. Device discovery precedes timing. The first CUDA model and prediction are timed in its checkpoint.
protocol.geometry: Conservative bidirectional surface check: nearest of opposing vertices and triangle centroids, pooled within each direction; report the larger directional p95 and maximum.
protocol.inputs: Native measured fingertips; all five region loads below 8 N. Identical representatives, signed labels, covariance, regularization, length, 4 mm grid, support mask and zero-surface extraction.
